The team was led by head coach [[Mark Few]], in his 21st season as head coach. This was the Bulldogs' 16th season at the on-campus [[McCarthey Athletic Center]] and 40th season as a member of the [[West Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 31–2, 15–1 in WCC play to be WCC regular season champions. They defeated [[2019–20 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|San Francisco]] and [[2019–20 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]] to be champions of the [[2020 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]]. They earned the WCC's automatic bid to the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. However, all postseason play, including the NCAA Tournament, was cancelled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], making this season the only one under Mark Few that they did not play in the NCAA Tournament. ==Previous season== {{main|2018–19 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team}} The Bulldogs team finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 33–4, 16–0 in WCC play to win the WCC regular season championship. After losing to [[2018–19 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]] in the [[2019 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]], they received an at-large bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], where they defeated [[2018–19 Fairleigh Dickinson Knights men's basketball team|Fairleigh Dickinson]] in the Round of 64, [[2018–19 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Baylor]] in the Round of 32, and then [[2018–19 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] in the Sweet Sixteen, before losing to [[2018–19 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]] in the Elite Eight. ==Offseason== ===Coaching changes=== ====Departures==== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:90%;" border="1" !
